in_marathi.name: Champalal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Power and Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Champalal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Champa (lotus) + Lal (red) - The name Champalal is derived from Sanskrit. The name is composed of two words - Champa, which means lotus, and Lal, which means red. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna is often depicted as standing on a lotus flower. The red color symbolizes power, prosperity, and wealth. Therefore, the name Champalal is believed to signify the god of wealth, power, and prosperity.
